notes.title: DEATH TALES 2021 ROADMAP
notes.notes: Who's ready for some Death Tales DLC?! Keep an eye out early next year for release date announcements!

notes.title: BEHOLD! Today's bounties!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/44c48b5ca4f8cd720aad7855d32c1c1f95fc6108.png[/img]

Death wishes the souls of these! Today a bounty is being offered for the elimination of Skull Witches! Destroy the wicked spell casters and you will be rewarded handsomely.

notes.title: Ready for a new spell?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/4828886bf5492ce687b022a3ea4fc4a4d297460b.png[/img]

Greetings small Reaper. Might you be interested in learning a new spell? Today I'm going to teach you Tornado. Send tornadoes whirling at your enemies, sending them spinning in the updraft, leaving them open for attack!

notes.title: Are you ready to answer to the Grim Reaper?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/73c8f381a9dd58856b40e4d2b13da18453f7245c.png[/img]

The Grim Reaper has a special assignment for you to complete. He senses a strong essence trapped in a body, sick with fever. Find it and return it to the Grim Reaper and in return he will reward you. But are you up for the task?...

notes.title: New patch up
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/0856f39814d8ab984618cf7116dac0e638b4988b.png[/img]

We just uploaded a small patch containing some bug fixes, such as world 5 unlocking before you beat the boss in world 4. And a few minor other changes. If there is any issues you encounter please make sure to let us know.

notes.title: Check out my new inventory for today!
notes.notes: I'm Fiona, welcome to my shop! I have a variety of novelties and odds and ends to assist you on your adventure! Today on sale we have Armor for Life! Slip this on while battling foes to be immune to some damage and possibly spawn a Life Soul! Get your Armor for Life today for the fair price of 200 souls! What do you say, small Reaper?

notes.title: Death wishes the souls of these...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/2e1e4804d6c3ec407112c70d9eaabb4c569da9b4.png[/img]

Today a bounty is being offered for the elimination of Gate Guardians. Eliminate these round, mechanical, bomb-launching, nasty, hulking beasts and you will be rewarded handsomely!

notes.title: Welcome to my shop! Today we have...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/8c2e86550539ce4278e58ce83b3a466588383d24.png[/img]

I'm Fiona, welcome to my shop! I have a variety of novelties and odds and ends to assist you on your adventure! Today on sale we have a Rocket Totem! Plant this to fire rockets for several seconds at your enemies! Perfect for getting yourself out of a pickle! Get your Rocket Totem today for  the fair price of 400 souls! What do you say, small Reaper?

notes.title: Meet Inan
notes.notes:
Meet Inan: protector of forests, giver of spells, and scarer of scarecrows. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/0b756cd6e3614e1985f899f409689feb72cfda3c.png[/img]

Inan can be found in the woods and is always eager to teach you various spells to assist you on your journey in exchange for souls! Her repertoire changes every day, so be sure to seek her out to find out what new spells she has in store for you!

notes.title: Meet the Lead Reaper
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/8ef3f356977d3060b0cc25d631cef1f721f5232a.png[/img]

Meet the Lead Reaper that is in charge of handing out bounties. Accept Death's challenges and eliminate enemies for extra souls that you can use to purchase weapons, equipment, and spells to help you along your journey! The ever-wanting Death is always in need of souls, so be sure to check back with the Lead Reaper every day for new bounties!

notes.title: Meet Fiona
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38725808/85dac85705783437bafee805c0d84216b0124117.png[/img]

Meet Fiona the shopkeeper! Fiona sells a variety of armor, spells, and other equipment to assist you on your journey in exchange for souls. Today she is offering a Heart to expand your life, and also a spell called Poison Hand which spawns a sickly, poisonous hand used to attack your enemies. Her inventory changes every day, so check back to see what kind of items she has in stock tomorrow!
